claims: The game was in the 2026 ACC Tournament quarterfinals
North Carolina Tar Heels had a late 18-point second-half rally
Clemson Tigers advanced to the ACC Tournament semifinals
Henri Veesaar led UNC with 28 points
Henri Veesaar led UNC with 17 rebounds
Final score was Clemson Tigers 80, North Carolina Tar Heels 79
Venue was Spectrum Center, Charlotte, N.C.
Nick Davidson scored 17 points for Clemson
Dillon Hunter scored 14 points for Clemson
Henri Veesaar scored 28 points for UNC
Derek Dixon scored 16 points for UNC
Clemson advanced to the ACC Tournament semifinals to face the winner of the Duke/FSU game
The game was played on March 12, 2026
